name: Sanrhea Technical Textile Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1983, Sanrhea Technical 
 Textiles Ltd manufactures Industrial Fabrics 
 like Conveyor Belting fabrics, Chafer fabrics, 
 etc.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
STTL is an IS0 9001:14001 certified manufacturer of RFL Dipped Fabrics and Nylon & Polyester-based Heavy Industrial Fabrics. It offers product solutions for India’s leading Tyre, Conveyor-Belt and Rubber Component 
& products manufacturing industries

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 21.5%
